name: Grown Children Treating Their Parents
overview: Scripture commands grown children to honor and respect their parents, promising long life as a blessing for obedience (Exodus 20:12). Disregarding or cursing one's parents brings severe consequences, described as a curse or extinguishing of one's lamp (Deuteronomy 27:16; Proverbs 20:20). The Proverbs also emphasize the importance of parental discipline and training during childhood, which lays a foundation for lifelong faithfulness and proper conduct (Proverbs 13:24; 19:18; 22:6). Together, these verses affirm a God-ordained order where grown children maintain reverence and care toward their parents as an expression of love and obedience to the Lord.
